items.title: Is Bloom Energy Worth $177 After Three Guidance Raises?
items.summary: Bloom Energy (BE) closed at $177.28 on Monday, Nov 16, down 7.7% on the day and 48.7% below its June 22 closing high. Yet the company has raised its 2026 outlook for revenue, operating income and EPS three times this year. So what does a share at $177.28 now pay for.
